# GitHub Dark Dimmed

GitHub Dark Dimmed reproduces the GitHub dark dimmed appearance in Obsidian, together with kanban boards styled after GitHub Projects, GitHub-style callouts, inline code blocks and matching interface buttons. Header colors and the kanban and callout styles are toggled through the Style Settings plugin, and the theme index records dark mode only.

![GitHub Dark Dimmed screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rgormley/obsidian-github-dark-dimmed/HEAD/imgs/promo.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "GitHub Dark Dimmed"
    author: "@rgormley"
    repo:   "rgormley/obsidian-github-dark-dimmed"
    slug:   "github-dark-dimmed"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/github-dark-dimmed"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/rgormley/obsidian-github-dark-dimmed"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rgormley/obsidian-github-dark-dimmed/HEAD/imgs/promo.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a GitHub-inspired dark dimmed appearance to Obsidian with GitHub Projects–style kanban boards, GitHub-style callouts, inline code blocks, and matching UI buttons. Customize header colors and toggle kanban or callout styles through the Style Settings plugin."
}
```
